3407.title: Bulk file replies delay daemon heartbeats
3407.rootCauseOneLine: Under a measured 64 KiB/s bottleneck, file replies block later application heartbeats on the shared WebSocket until the acknowledgement lease expires; production attribution remains unverified.
3407.proposedFix: Run the full preview path with constrained transport and small RPC measurements before choosing a transport design.
3407.caveats: Synthetic session registrar and acknowledgement receiver; no end-to-end HTTP 504, Tailscale topology, provider failures, or repeated replacement loop reproduced.
